name: racha-ai
description: Divida as contas do rolê e quite tudo com o mínimo de PIX.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix api run db:setup
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix api run start:dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix api run test:e2e && npm --prefix web test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix api run lint && npm --prefix web run lint
